kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Cancers 2025;17(18):3010 · 前瞻
title: Prospective Evaluation of Cervical Scrapings CDO1/CELF4 Methylation (epiHERA®) in EC Detection
title_zh: 宫颈刮片 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化（epiHERA®）检测子宫内膜癌的前瞻性评估
subtitle: 675 Hong Kong women — accuracy 97.3%, sensitivity 84.1%, specificity 98.8% (AUC 0.92); 96% fewer invasive checks
subtitle_zh: 675 例香港女性——准确度 97.3%，灵敏度 84.1%，特异度 98.8%（AUC 0.92）；侵入性检查减少 96%
authors: Lee HSJ, Wu S, Yeung SY, Cheung CW, Fung WYL, Kwok PKS, Yung KK, Wong TKS, Kanneganti A, Lau TS
authors_zh: 李浩诗, 吴诗烨, 杨雪盈, 张俊伟, 冯颖琳, 郭珮琪, 容嘉琪, 黄子祺, Kanneganti A, 刘达山

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: EC workup needs invasive endometrial sampling — a non-invasive cervical test could triage who needs it.
Question: how accurate is the epiHERA® CDO1/CELF4 assay on cervical scrapings in a prospective cohort?
Why it matters: a 96% reduction in invasive checks would transform EC diagnosis economics.
bullets_zh: 空白：EC 检查需要侵入性内膜取样——无创宫颈检测可分流谁需要。
问题：epiHERA® CDO1/CELF4 试剂盒在前瞻队列中对宫颈刮片的准确性如何？
意义：侵入性检查减少 96% 将变革 EC 诊断经济学。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective cross-sectional (Jan 2023–Nov 2024); Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong.
Population: 675 with AUB/suspected pathology (mean 58.7 y, 79.7% postmenopausal; 629 outpatient + 46 hysterectomy).
Methylation: epiHERA® qMS-PCR on ThinPrep cervical scrapings; ΔCtCDO1 ≤ 8.4 or ΔCtCELF4 ≤ 8.8.
Reference: same-day endometrial histology.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性横断面（2023.1–2024.11）；香港威尔士亲王医院。
人群：675 例 AUB/可疑病变（平均 58.7 岁，79.7% 绝经后；门诊 629 + 子宫切除 46）。
甲基化：epiHERA® qMS-PCR 检测 ThinPrep 宫颈刮片；ΔCtCDO1 ≤ 8.4 或 ΔCtCELF4 ≤ 8.8。
金标准：同日子宫内膜组织学。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Combined assay: accuracy 97.3% · sensitivity 84.1% · specificity 98.8% · PPV 89.2% · NPV 98.2% · Kappa 0.85.
Outpatient subgroup: accuracy 98.1%, NPV 99.17%, false-negative rate 0.8%.
96% fewer invasive checks: only 25/629 methylation-positive needed invasive sampling.
Early signal: 4 of 7 false-positives diagnosed cancer within 1–4 months — methylation may precede histology.
bullets_zh: 联合检测：准确度 97.3% · 灵敏度 84.1% · 特异度 98.8% · PPV 89.2% · NPV 98.2% · Kappa 0.85。
门诊亚组：准确度 98.1%，NPV 99.17%，假阴性率 0.8%。
侵入性检查减少 96%：629 例中仅 25 例甲基化阳性需侵入性取样。
早期信号：7 例假阳性中 4 例 1–4 个月后确诊癌——甲基化或早于组织学。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Triage gate: negative methylation safely defers invasive evaluation (NPV 98.2%).
ET ≤ 4 mm: accuracy 99.6%, sensitivity 100% — strongest in low-ET women.
Cost: fewer procedures, lower cost — a high-value addition to EC pathways.
bullets_zh: 分流闸门：甲基化阴性可安全推迟侵入性评估（NPV 98.2%）。
ET ≤ 4 mm：准确度 99.6%，灵敏度 100%——低 ET 女性中最强。
成本：更少操作、更低成本——EC 路径的高价值补充。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: 96% fewer invasive procedures at 97.3% accuracy — the epiHERA® triage works in real-world Hong Kong practice.
May outpace histology: methylation turned positive before tissue diagnosis in 4 cases.
bullets_zh: 侵入性操作减少 96%且准确度 97.3%——epiHERA® 分流在香港真实世界实践有效。
或领先组织学：4 例甲基化在组织学确诊前即转阳。

kicker: Endometrial Cancer · Front Med 2026;13:1690020 · Paired-Sample Validation
kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Front Med 2026;13:1690020 · 配对样本验证
title: Validation of a Cervical CDO1/CELF4 Methylation Test vs Intrauterine Specimen
title_zh: 宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化检测与宫内标本的配对验证
subtitle: 226 paired CBC vs D&C samples — cervical AUC 0.916 vs intrauterine 0.929 (no difference); R=0.86
subtitle_zh: 226 例配对宫颈刷 vs 诊刮样本——宫颈 AUC 0.916 vs 宫内 0.929（无差异）；R=0.86
authors: Cai B, Wang Y, Ma W, Wu Z, Yao T, Liu P, Wang L, Zhou P, Li Y
authors_zh: 蔡炳鑫, 王依杉, 马文, 吴珍珍, 姚婷婷, 刘沛, 王林海, 周萍萍, 李怡林

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: the non-invasive cervical brush (CBC) test needed direct head-to-head proof against intrauterine D&C specimens.
Question: does cervical CDO1/CELF4 methylation match invasive intrauterine sampling for EIN/EC?
Why it matters: equivalence would justify replacing invasive sampling with cervical brushing.
bullets_zh: 空白：无创宫颈刷（CBC）检测需要与宫内诊刮（D&C）标本的直接头对头证据。
问题：宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化是否与侵入性宫内采样检测 EIN/EC 相当？
意义：等效性将支持用宫颈刷取代侵入性采样。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective paired-sample study (Jul 2023–Jun 2024); Gansu Provincial Maternity & Child Care Hospital.
Population: 226 hysteroscopy-indicated women (9 EIN + 22 EC; 195 benign).
Sampling: Cervex-Brush (CBC) vs D&C — both tested blinded with CISENDO®.
Analysis: log ΔCt correlation, Bland-Altman, ROC/DeLong.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性配对样本研究（2023.7–2024.6）；甘肃省妇幼保健院。
人群：226 例宫腔镜指征女性（EIN 9 + EC 22；良性 195）。
采样：Cervex 刷（CBC）vs 诊刮（D&C）——均盲法 CISENDO® 检测。
分析：log ΔCt 相关、Bland-Altman、ROC/DeLong。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: High concordance: CDO1 R=0.86, CELF4 R=0.78; Bland-Altman no systematic bias.
Performance parity: CBC AUC 0.916 (sens 90.3% / spec 92.8%) vs D&C 0.929 (93.5%/92.3%) — no significant difference (P=0.244).
vs clinical: ET AUC 0.499, CA125 0.593 — traditional markers cannot distinguish EIN/EC.
Type-II EC: 100% detected on D&C; 2/3 on CBC.
bullets_zh: 高度一致：CDO1 R=0.86、CELF4 R=0.78；Bland-Altman 无系统偏倚。
性能相当：CBC AUC 0.916（灵敏度 90.3% / 特异度 92.8%）vs 诊刮 0.929（93.5%/92.3%）——无显著差异（P=0.244）。
vs 临床指标：ET AUC 0.499、CA125 0.593——传统标志物无法区分 EIN/EC。
II 型 EC：诊刮 100% 检出；CBC 2/3。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Equivalence proven: non-invasive cervical brushing matches invasive sampling — the case for replacing D&C as first line.
Menopausal: premenopausal CBC AUC 0.943 / postmenopausal 0.856.
Path forward: external validation before routine clinical adoption.
bullets_zh: 等效性证实：无创宫颈刷与侵入性采样相当——支持以宫颈刷取代诊刮作为一线。
绝经分层：绝经前 CBC AUC 0.943 / 绝经后 0.856。
前进路径：常规临床采用前需外部验证。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Non-invasive = invasive: CBC matches D&C (AUC 0.916 vs 0.929) — a paradigm shift for EC sampling.
Reliable triage: cervical brushing could replace intrauterine sampling in symptomatic women.
bullets_zh: 无创 = 有创：宫颈刷与诊刮相当（AUC 0.916 vs 0.929）——EC 采样的范式转变。
可靠分流：宫颈刷可在有症状女性中取代宫内采样。
